thm:conditional-RH-regulator.title: Conditional critical-line regulator theorem
thm:conditional-RH-regulator.note: Proved 2026-08-14 (wave 12). The previously disclosed complex-analytic layer (Hurwitz's theorem for locally uniform holomorphic limits) is now formalized from scratch. ConditionalRHRegulatorExact.lean proves: (1) hurwitz_ne_zero - Hurwitz's theorem in local nonvanishing form: if holomorphic F_n -> F locally uniformly on an open set, the F_n are eventually zero-free on a closed ball around z0, and F is not locally identically zero at z0, then F(z0) != 0. Proof by the maximum-modulus principle applied to 1/F_n on a small disc: isolated zeros via AnalyticAt.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero select a sphere where |F| >= delta > 0, uniform convergence forces |F_n| >= delta/2 on the sphere, Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le bounds 1/F_n at the center, so |F_n(z0)| >= delta/2, contradicting F_n(z0) -> F(z0) = 0. (2) specDet_zero_re - every zero of the finite spectral determinant D_A(s) = det(1 - e^{-ls}A) with A^H A = c*1 lies on Re s = log c/(2l): an explicit resonating eigenvector from det = 0 (Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff) satisfies Av = e^{ls}v, and the dot-product norm identity ||Av||^2 = c||v||^2 forces |e^{ls}|^2 = c. Note A^H A = c*1 with c > 0 subsumes the manuscript's normality hypothesis (a one-sided matrix inverse is two-sided). (3) conditional_RH_regulator - the boxed conclusion: for F_X = h_X D_{A_X} with nowhere-zero holomorphic h_X, F_X -> F locally uniformly on an open preconnected domain, F not identically zero, and a_X/2 = log c_X/(2 l_X) -> a/2, every zero of F lies on Re s = a/2. Proof: a ball around a putative off-line zero eventually misses the moving critical lines, so the F_X are eventually zero-free there (zero-line theorem + nowhere-zero h_X); the identity theorem (eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero) rules out local vanishing of F; Hurwitz gives F(z0) != 0, contradiction. The prior partial files for thm:eigenvalue-zero-lines remain cited. All declarations standard axioms; strict lake build zero new warnings.
